data.name: Chesed
data.gender_notes: Chesed is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Hebrew word Chesed represents the divine attribute of loving-kindness and mercy. In the Old Testament, it is used to describe God's steadfast love and faithfulness to His people. Chesed is also a virtue that calls for acts of compassion and kindness towards others. The name Chesed carries the meaning “Loving-kindness, Mercy, Compassion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Chesed usually hope their child will grow to embody loving-kindness, mercy, compassion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's love and compassion towards humanity.
data.etymology: Chesed belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Loving-kindness, Mercy, Compassion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chesed total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: חסד
in_hebrew.meaning: חסד הוא שם שפירושו חסד, טוב, וחמלה בעברית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: חסד הוא שם שמקורו בתנ"ך העברי, ופירושו חסד, טוב, וחמלה. הוא נגזר מהמילה 'חסד' שפירושה חסד אלוהי, טוב, ורחמים. השם חסד מופיע מספר פעמים בתנ"ך, ומשמעותו היא התגלות של חסד אלוהי וטובו כלפי בני האדם. השם חסד הוא שם נפוץ בקרב יהודים ונוצרים כאחד, ומשמעותו הרוחנית היא התגלות של חסד אלוהי וטובו.

in_greek.name: Χεσέδ
in_greek.meaning: Χεσέδ σημαίνει καλοσύνη, έλεος και συμπόνια στα Ελληνικά
in_greek.long_meaning: Χεσέδ είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την Εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει καλοσύνη, έλεος και συμπόνια. Στο Χριστιανισμό, το όνομα Χεσέδ συνδέεται με την έννοια της θείας καλοσύνης και του ελέους. Το όνομα Χεσέδ δεν εμφανίζεται άμεσα στη Νέα Διαθήκη, αλλά η έννοια της καλοσύνης και του ελέους είναι κεντρική στο μήνυμα του Ευαγγελίου.

in_latin.name: Chesed
in_latin.meaning: Chesed significat misericordia, bonitas, et clementia in Latino
in_latin.long_meaning: Chesed est nomen Hebraeum quod significat misericordia, bonitas, et clementia. In traditione Christiana, nomen Chesed coniungitur cum conceptu misericordiae et bonitatis divinae. Quamvis nomen Chesed non appareat directe in Scripturis Latinis, notio misericordiae et bonitatis est centralis in doctrina Christiana.

In Christian tradition, Chesed is associated with the concept of divine mercy and goodness. Although it does not appear directly in the Bible, the concept of chesed is central to the biblical message of God's love and redemption. The name Chesed conveys spiritual meaning, personality traits of compassion, and kindness, and is used across Christian cultures.
